Game Overview

Save kitten puts players into a animal experience centered on catch kittens on your trampoline in a thrilling rescue mission against time. Navigate the vibrant tower, customize your hero, and dodge bombs while collecting boosters and coins. Swift reflexes and strategy are key to filling the basket and securing your spot on the competitive leaderboard.
